verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly suggests bulk capability. The web API can programmatically 'manage and export data', the Issues page supports filtering issues by properties, and Seer Autofix automatically scans and triages incoming issues in aggregate. None of this explicitly documents user-initiated bulk actions across many items. Missing for 10: explicit bulk issue operations (e.g. bulk resolve/assign/merge), documented bulk API endpoints, bulk actions exposed via MCP for AI agents, and hands-on corroboration.
